Name: BRAMBLE WHIP
Main Effect:
You summon forth a vine from the ground to whip an **entity you can see** within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a **{stat} Ranged Attack** {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[1d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Bramble Whip**, you may spend an additional **1 Action Point** and **1 Willpower** any number of times.

For each time you do, target an additional **eligible entity** with **Bramble Whip**.

Name: BARKSKIN
Main Effect:
You cover the skin of a creature you **can touch** with bark.

The target gains [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in **Shield** and **+1 Defense**.

This effect is lost when all **Shield** is depleted.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Barkskin**, you may spend an additional **1 Action Point** and **1 Willpower** any number of times.

For each time you do, the target entity gains an additional [[1d6 + stat]] in **Shield**.

Name: ENTANGLING ROOTS
Main Effect:
Roots burst from the ground, covering a **6-meter (20-foot)** area centered on a point you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

Make a **{stat} Roll** {roll} against the **Reflex** of all entities in the area. On a success, they are **rooted** for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

Entities rooted by this spell can spend **6 Action Points** to break out of the vines.

Name: SLEEPING SPORES
Main Effect:
You manifest a **6-meter (20-foot)** cloud of invisible, odorless spores centered on a point you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a **{stat} Roll** {roll} against the **Grit** of all entities in the area. Entities that are currently in combat or can see you gain **advantage** on the roll.

On a success, the entity falls **asleep** for **1 hour**. This effect ends early if the target takes damage or an entity uses an action to shake them awake.

Name: PARASITIC SPORE
Main Effect:
You launch a burrowing spore pod at an **entity you can see** within **12 meters (40 feet)**.

Make a **{stat} Ranged Attack** {roll} against the target. On a hit, the spore embeds itself in the target.

At your **Turn End**, the embedded spore deals [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage to the target, and you regain **Health** equal to half the damage dealt.
Secondary Effect:
At your **Turn Start**, you must pay **2 Willpower** to maintain the spore on the target.

If you do not pay the Upkeep, the spell effect ends.

Name: VERDANT FIELD
Main Effect:
You create a field of greenery in a **30-meter (100-foot)** radius centered on yourself for **1 hour**.

Entities taking a **Short Rest** inside gain [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in **Shield** and **1 Karma**.

Standing in the field **elevates** your **Flora** spells by **1**.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Verdant Field**, you may spend an additional **3 Action Points** and **4 Willpower**.

If you do, the field lasts for **24 hours**, or becomes permanent in natural terrain, and entities taking a **Long Rest** inside also receive the **Short Rest** benefits and reduce their **Supplies** cost by **1**.

Name: THORN RAMPART
Main Effect:
You conjure a dense wall of razor-sharp briars at a location you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)** for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

The wall can be up to **12 meters (40 feet)** long, **1.5 meters (5 feet)** thick and **3 meters (10 feet)** tall, blocking **line of sight**.

Any entity attempting to pass through the wall or having their **Turn Start** in it takes [[3d6 + 3*stat]] in {damage} damage, and you make a **{stat} Roll** {roll} against that entity’s **Grit**.

On a success, the entity becomes **rooted** until the end of its turn.

Name: NATURALIZE
Main Effect:
You touch a **common object**, instantly breaking it down into decaying organic matter and destroying it.

The object cannot exceed **200 kg (440 lbs)** in weight or a **2-meter (6-foot)** cube in size, and cannot be metallic.

If the object is being worn or held by an entity, you must make a successful **{stat} Melee Attack** {roll} against the target to destroy it.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Naturalize**, you may spend an additional **3 Action Points** and **6 Willpower**.

If you do, you can target **uncommon objects**.

Name: WILD STRIDER
Main Effect:
You embody the freedom of the wild until your next **Long Rest**.

The **Action Point** cost of your {{Move}} action can no longer exceed **1 Action Point**, and your **Movement Speed** cannot be reduced by any effect.

Additionally, your jump distance and jump height are **doubled**.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Wild Strider**, you may spend an additional **1 Action Point** and **1 Willpower** any number of times.

For each time you do, target an additional entity you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)** with **Wild Strider**.

Name: SNAKE!
Main Effect:
You manifest a snake spirit which hurls itself at an **entity you can see** within **6 meters (20 feet)**.

Make a **{stat} Ranged Attack** {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage, and the target is **poisoned**.

Name: SHARPEN SENSES
Main Effect:
You channel the spirit of the wild to heighten your perception for **1 hour**.

For the duration of the spell, you gain **advantage** on all **skill checks** that rely on one of your five senses.
Secondary Effect:
While **Sharpen Senses** is active, when you fail a **skill check** that relies on one of your five senses, you may spend **2 Willpower** to **reroll** the check.

You can only use this effect once per **skill check**.

Name: PRIMAL ROAR
Main Effect:
You emulate the ferocity of the wild, letting out a bellowing roar that echoes across the battlefield.

Make a **{stat} Roll** {roll} against the **Grit** of all hostile entities that can hear you within **36 meters (120 feet)**.

On a success, the entity must spend **2 Action Points** on its next turn to move away from you. If the target has any **Reaction Points** available, it immediately spends them to start moving away from you first.

Name: WILD SWEEP
Main Effect:
You manifest the spirit of a large flying creature that swoops down on an **entity you can see** within **12 meters (40 feet)**.

Make a **{stat} Ranged Attack** {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage, and the target is carried **12 meters (40 feet)** in any direction of your choice.
Secondary Effect:
When **Wild Sweep** hits, you may spend an additional **1 Action Point** and **1 Willpower** any number of times.

For each time you do, the target is carried an additional **3 meters (10 feet)**.

Name: SAVAGE SLAM
Main Effect:
You manifest the spirit of a mighty beast to slam the ground in a **6-meter (20-foot)** cone in front of you.

Make a **{stat} Attack Roll** {roll} against all entities in the area. On a hit, you deal [[4d6 + 4*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Savage Slam**, you may spend an additional **2 Action Points** and **2 Willpower**.

If you do, the spell affects a **6-meter (20-foot)** radius centered on you instead of a cone.

Name: PACK BOND
Main Effect:
You form a predatory bond with up to **5 allies you can see** for **10 turns (1 minute)**, binding you together as a **Wild Pack**. While this spell is active:

Attack rolls against a Wild Pack member have **disadvantage** while that member is adjacent to at least one other Wild Pack member.

Wild Pack members gain **advantage** on attack rolls against an entity if at least **2** Wild Pack members are adjacent to that same entity.

If a Wild Pack member falls **unconscious** or dies, every remaining member’s next attack is a guaranteed **critical** hit. Friendly fire and self-harm cannot trigger this effect.

Name: BIRD VIEW
Main Effect:
You manifest a small spectral flying creature and project your consciousness into it for up to **1 hour**.

For the duration, you gain an aerial view of the surrounding area through the creature’s senses up to **500 meters (1,500 feet)** away from your physical body.

While controlling the creature, your physical body is **incapacitated** and cannot take actions.

You may end **Bird View** early.

Name: FORCE INEBRIATION
Main Effect:
You attempt to ferment the blood of an **entity you can see** within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

Make a **{stat} Roll** {roll} against the target’s **Grit**. On a success, the target becomes **poisoned**.

Outside of combat, the target is unaware of the spell’s source and believes they became suddenly sick.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Force Inebriation**, you may spend an additional **1 Action Point** and **1 Willpower** any number of times.

For each time you do, target an additional **eligible entity** within range.

Name: SENSE LIFE
Main Effect:
You open your awareness to the pulse and life force of surrounding living organisms.

For **10 turns (1 minute)**, you sense the exact location and health state of all living entities within **18 meters (60 feet)**, even through total cover or darkness.
Secondary Effect:
While **Sense Life** is active, you may spend **3 Action Points** and **3 Willpower** to **mark** an entity within range.

You continue to sense the marked entity’s location and health state until your next **Long Rest**, even if the target leaves your range.

Name: RENEW
Main Effect: You mend the flesh of an **entity you touch**, restoring [[1d6 + stat]] in **Health** immediately and again at the **Turn Start** of the target’s next **2** turns.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Renew**, you may spend an additional **2 Action Points** and **2 Willpower**.

If you do, you instantly restore [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in **Health** to all entities currently affected by your **Renew**, regardless of range or **line of sight**.

Name: GIANT GROWTH
Main Effect: You infuse an **entity you can touch** with life energy, tripling its size, doubling its **Movement Speed** and granting it **Empowered** for **10 turns**.
Secondary Effect: When casting **Giant Growth**, you may spend **3 Willpower** for each additional **entity you can touch**.

Name: BLEEDING TRAIL
Main Effect:
You touch a blood sample to create a trail of red mist that **only you can see**.

The trail lasts for **12 hours** and, if followed, leads you directly to the entity the blood came from.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Bleeding Trail**, you may sacrifice **Health** equal to your **{physique}** [[physique]].

If you do so, you receive a clear mental image of the entity the blood originated from.

Name: BLOOD SPEAR
Main Effect:
You manifest a spear of blood and hurl it at an **entity you can see** within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a **{stat} Ranged Attack** {roll} against the target. On a hit, you deal [[3d6 + 3*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Blood Spear**, you may sacrifice **Health** equal to your **{physique}** [[physique]].

If you do so, the attack is made with **advantage** and the damage is **Empowered** by **1**.

Name: GORE ARMOR
Main Effect:
You expend some of your blood to create a protective layer.

You sacrifice **Health** equal to [[3*physique]] and gain **Shield** equal to [[6*physique]].
Secondary Effect:
When casting this spell, you may sacrifice a further **Health** equal to [[2*physique]].

If you do so, you gain additional **Shield** equal to the **Health** sacrificed.

Name: VAMPIRIC TOUCH
Main Effect:
You attempt to drain the life force of an **entity you can touch**.

Make a **{stat} Melee Attack** {roll} against the target. On a hit, you deal [[3d6 + 3*stat]] in {damage} damage and regain **Health** equal to half the damage dealt.
Secondary Effect:
When casting **Vampiric Touch**, you may sacrifice **Health** equal to your **{physique}** [[physique]].

If you do so, the attack is made with **advantage** and the damage is **Empowered** by **1**.
